integrity: Finite calculations verify examples; structural and analytic arguments establish the general statements. The original fiber lemma and minimum-size formula are prior work; non-independent review and residual publication-priority uncertainty are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Fixed clique order q>=3; no claim about q=2 or uniformity in q. The all-parameter proof is not externally certified. Prior general weak-partition criteria can enable enumeration in principle.
title: Independent-domination polynomials and Gaussian size laws for path–clique tensor products
